message.content:
This document is a technical README/engineering log for **Project Maya**, an open-source inference engine for large MoE models (GLM-5.3-Flash, DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash-1017, MiniMax-M3.1-Flash) with a focus on running them on consumer/prosumer hardware. Key technical points:

**Models & Quantization**
- Maya ships its own quants (XS/S/M/L tiers by expert bit-width) of GLM-5.3-Flash, DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash-1017, and MiniMax-M3.1
